property_summary: For any codeless recipient funded from a nonzero contract balance, a first-bonus withdrawal plus a repeated withdrawReward to the same recipient drains exactly 100 wei total from address(c).balance, because the reference zeroes rewardsForA before paying; the mutant never zeroes it, so the repeated withdrawal pays the reward again and drains 200 wei.
change_summary: Delete the zeroing of rewardsForA[recipient] before the transfer, so rewards are not cleared and can be withdrawn repeatedly.
